evidence: PSBT area label and changes to PSBT input handling in src/psbt.cpp that directly affect wallet signing workflows (walletprocesspsbt).
rationale: Fixes an issue where joined PSBTs containing signed Taproot inputs retain invalid signatures and cannot be signed or finalized with walletprocesspsbt. While legacy and SegWit v0 signatures were already cleared in PartiallySignedTransaction::AddInput, Taproot signatures were not, leading to walletprocesspsbt returning complete: false.
